title: The Biological Ship of Theseus
hook: Most of your body is only a few years old.
script: Most of your body is only a few years old. Every single day, you replace approximately 330 billion cells. Your taste buds regenerate every two weeks, meaning your flavor perception is physically different today than it was fourteen days ago. What if you're basically a brand-new person every few years? Almost, but not entirely. The neurons in your brain and the lenses of your eyes are as old as you are. Your skeleton renews itself every ten years, like a slow-motion river of calcium moving beneath your skin. But the enamel on your teeth can never regenerate because the cells that create it die once the tooth erupts. You are a walking archive of the only parts of you that never changed.
